text:
maria: Heads up — starting change window for svc-embed v2 rollout. DeployBot will run preflight in ~2m. Please watch the embed-route SLOs (p95, 5xx). I'm pinning v2 to riser-03 for this ramp.

deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: preflight checks started for svc-embed:v2 -> riser-03. Running smoke, infra health, and observability snapshots. Current step: preparing traffic split.

observability-bot: OBS SNAPSHOT: baseline p95=310ms, p99=870ms, 5xx=0.11%. Error budget remaining=4.5%. Link: https://obs.redwood/svc-embed/snapshots/1708509123

ryan: what are the hard pause thresholds for this rollout?

maria: pause if p95 > 450ms OR 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 2m OR error budget drops >2% within a 5m window. Also treat region-local spikes as immediate hold.

tara: seeing short p99 spikes (~1.3s) in eu-west-1 right at the start of the shift. Small traffic tail.

observability-bot: REGION SNAP: eu-west-1 p95=420ms, p99=1300ms, 5xx=0.18% — spike coincides with cache miss increase. Trace sample: https://traces.redwood/trace/aa12

sre-lead: If cache miss rate > 2x baseline during ramp, hold and investigate kv/cache path. Prefer pausing ramp rather than rollback unless 5xx crosses threshold.

deploy-bot: ACTION: shifting traffic 10% -> 30% over 5m as configured (ramp plan id: rp-2026-03). Current traffic: 18%.

jules: seeing redis timeouts increase and kv-cache misses up ~3x. Tracing shows higher latencies on kv-get. Might be config-related.

maria: pausing ramp at current 18% to avoid crossing p95 threshold. Not rolling back yet. We need a quick config change to prefer local cache fallback. @ryan can you push a config tweak?

ryan: on it. Applying hotpatch to service config:

```
# hotfix
cache.policy=prefer_cached
cache.fallback=soft_miss
```

Changing to:

```
cache.policy=prefer_kv
cache.fallback=aggressive_prefetch
```

ryan: Pushed config as svc-embed:cfg-hotfix-1708509190, restarting pods in riser-03.

deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: hotfix rollout triggered, pods restarting (graceful). Will re-run smoke and observability snapshot post-restart.

observability-bot: POST-PATCH SNAP: p95=340ms, p99=910ms, 5xx=0.08%. kv-cache miss rate back to baseline. Link: https://obs.redwood/svc-embed/snapshots/1708509255

maria: Nice. Resume ramp to 60% but keep close watch for 10m. Update release notes: add cache-policy tweak and monitoring blurb. Also log the pause/patch in the changelog.

sre-lead: add an alert for kv-cache-miss-rate > 1.5x baseline during ramps to the release playbook.

jules: added note to runbook and created a small postmortem checklist item.

maria: ok thanks team — continuing ramp, will re-evaluate at 60%. :thumbsup:
